cards.title: Sapling of the White Tree
cards.gameText: To play, spot an unbound [GONDOR] Man. Response: If a [GONDOR] Man is about to take a wound, discard this artifact to prevent that.
cards.lore: “‘Verily this is a sapling of the line of Nimloth the fair; and that was a seedling of Galathilion, and that a fruit of Telperion of many names, Eldest of Trees.'”

fields.title: Schössling des weißen Baumes
fields.lore: "Fürwahr, das ist ein Schössling aus dem Stamm von Nimloth dem Schönen; und der war ein Sämling von Galathilion, und dieser wiederum die Frucht von Telperion, dem Vielnamigen, dem Ältesten der Bäume."

cards.title: Scroll of Isildur
cards.gameText: Tale. To play, spot a [GONDOR] Man. The Ring-bearer is resistance +1 for each [GONDOR] artifact you can spot (limit +3). Fellowship: Discard this artifact to play a ring from your discard pile.
cards.lore: “What evil it saith I do not know; but I trace here a copy of it, lest it fade beyond recall.”

fields.title: Scroll of Isildur

fields.lore: “What evil it saith I do not know; but I trace here a copy of it, lest it fade beyond recall.”

fields.title: Die Schriftrolle des Isildur
fields.lore: "Was sie Böses besaget, weiß ich nicht; aber ich zeichne hier eine Abschrift auf, falls sie so verblasset, dass sie nicht mehr zu erkennen ist."

cards.title: Seeing Stone of Minas Anor
cards.gameText: To play, spot a [GONDOR] Man with 3 or more vitality (or spot a [GONDOR] Man and add 2 threats). Regroup: Exert a [GONDOR] Man or discard this artifact to discard your hand and draw 3 cards.
cards.lore: “‘Didst thou think that the eyes of the White Tower were blind?'”

fields.lore: “‘Didst thou think that the eyes of the White Tower were blind?'”

fields.title: Der sehende Stein von Minas Anor
fields.lore: "Glaubtest du, dass die Augen des Weißen Turms blind seien?"

cards.title: Seeing Stone of Orthanc
cards.gameText: To play, spot a [GONDOR] Man with 3 or more vitality (or spot a [GONDOR] Man and add 2 threats). Regroup: Add a threat or discard this artifact to remove (2) or to draw a card.
cards.lore: “‘I am the lawful master of the Stone, and I had both the right and the strength to use it, or so I judged.'”

fields.title: Seeing Stone of Orthanc

fields.title: Der sehende Stein vom Orthanc
fields.lore: "Ich bin der rechtmäßige Herr des Steins, und ich habe das Recht und auch die Kraft, ihn zu gebrauchen, so beurteile ich es jedenfalls."

cards.title: Library of Orthanc
cards.gameText: Shadow: Play an [ISENGARD] minion to stack the top card of your draw deck on this card. Skirmish: Remove(1) and discard a Free Peoples card stacked here to make an [ISENGARD] minion strength +1. Regroup: Remove (1) to take an [ISENGARD] card stacked here into hand.

cards.title: Sack of the Shire
cards.gameText: If an [ISENGARD] minion wins a skirmish, until the regroup phase, make that minion strength +1 for each site you control and fierce.
cards.lore: “‘There's some devilry at work in the Shire....'”

fields.title: Sack of the Shire

fields.title: Plünderung des Auenlandes
fields.lore: "Da geht irgendeine Teufelei im Auenland vor sich."

cards.title: Host of Moria
cards.subtitle: Legion of the Underdeeps
cards.gameText: When you play Host of Moria, you may play a [MORIA] card from your discard pile.
cards.lore: “There was a horn-blast and a rush of feet, and orcs one after another leaped into the chamber.”

fields.title: Heer von Moria
fields.subtitle: Legionen des Unterreiches
fields.lore: Ein Hornstoß erscholl und ein Getrappel von Füßen war zu hören, und dann sprang ein Ork nach dem anderen in die Kammer.

cards.title: Ring of Asperity
cards.gameText: Bearer must be a Nazgul. When you play this artifact, you may wound an unwounded companion. Response: If a player reconciles, return bearer to his owner's hand.
cards.lore: “‘The Nine, the Seven, and the Three... had each their proper gem.'”

fields.title: Der Ring der Strenge
fields.lore: "Die Neun, die Sieben und die Drei... hatten alle einen eigenen Edelstein."

cards.title: Ring of Ire
cards.gameText: Bearer must be The Witch-king. Skirmish: Exert bearer twice to make a [WRAITH] minion damage +1. Response: If a player reconciles, return bearer to his owner's hand.
cards.lore: “‘Nine he gave to Mortal Men, proud and great, and so ensnared them.'”

fields.title: Der Ring der Wut
fields.lore: "Neun gab er den sterblichen Menschen, stolzen und großen Menschen, und so verführte er sie."

cards.title: Ring of Rancor
cards.gameText: Bearer must be a Nazgul. Maneuver: Remove a burden to heal each Nazgul. Response: If a player reconciles, return bearer to his owner's hand.
cards.lore: “‘So it is now: the Nine he has gathered to himself....'”

fields.title: Der Ring des Hasses
fields.lore: So steht es also nun: die Neun hat er für sich gewonnen..."

cards.title: Horn of the Mark
cards.gameText: Bearer must be Merry or Pippin. Bearer gains the Theoden signet. Response: If bearer wins a skirmish, exert him to discard each minion involved in that skirmish.
cards.lore: “‘He that blows it at need shall set fear in the hearts of his enemies and joy in the hearts of his friends....'”

fields.title: Horn of the Mark

fields.title: Das Horn der Mark
fields.lore: "Wer es bläst, wenn er in Not ist, erweckt Furcht im Herzen seiner Feinde und Freude im Herzen seiner Freunde..."

cards.title: The Red Arrow
cards.gameText: Assignment: Exert a [GONDOR] Man to play a [ROHAN] Man. You may exert that [ROHAN] Man to play a possession on him or her. Discard this artifact.
cards.lore: “‘The Red Arrow has not been seen in the Mark in all my years! Has it indeed come to that?'”

fields.title: The Red Arrow
fields.gameText: Fellowship: Discard this and exert a Man to take a Free Peoples Man of a different culture into hand from your draw deck. Regroup: Exert 2 of your Men to discard a Man from your dead pile. Remove this artifact from the game.

fields.title: Der Rote Pfeil
fields.lore: "Der rote Pfeil ist in all meinen Jahren nicht in der Mark gesehen worden! Ist es wirklich so weit gekommen?"

cards.title: Ithil Stone
cards.gameText: To play, exert a [WRAITH] or [SAURON] minion. At the start of each of your Shadow phases, you may draw a card. Shadow: Discard this artifact to play a [SAURON] minion. Its twilight cost is -3.
cards.lore: “‘...and in it there was a stone like the Moon....'”

fields.title: Ithilstein
fields.lore: "...und in ihm war ein Stein wie der Mond..."

cards.title: Sauron
cards.subtitle: The Lord of the Rings
cards.gameText: Damage +2. Enduring. Fierce. For each burden you spot, threat you spot, and site you control, Sauron's twilight cost is -1.
cards.lore: “One for the Dark Lord on his dark throne / In the Land of Mordor where the Shadows lie.”

fields.lore: "Einer dem Dunklen Herrn auf dunklem Thron / Im Lande Mordor, wo die Schatten drohn."

cards.lore: “‘But what has it got in its pocketses, eh?'”

fields.lore: "Was hat es in seinen Taschen?"

cards.lore: “‘...I'm the tall one, you're the short one.'”

fields.title: Alle wissen es
fields.lore: "Ich bin der Große, und du bist der Kleine."

cards.title: Goldberry
cards.subtitle: River-daughter

cards.lore: “‘Slender as the willow-wand, clearer than the water.'”

cards.subtitle: The Master

cards.lore: “‘Hey! Come derry dol! Can you hear me singing?'”
